pairs.registryProposal: Upward lesson: the repo's discriminated BriefingOutcome (sinceLeftBriefing.ts:47) shows the discrimination is only as good as each input's ability to be null - a store that defaults to [] and swallows fetch errors (alertSlice.ts:259) defeats it silently; delta-briefings could name 'every input must carry a not-loaded state' explicitly. Also last-seen-anchors could name the lazy/Suspense-mounted consumer whose first-render snapshot runs after an ancestor's mount effect - a component-world variant of the self-erasing stamp.
